title: Buddhist Temporalities (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE BUDDHIST TEMPORALITIES ORDINANCE .

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Parliament assembled, and by the authority of the same, as follows : - Short title
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Buddhist Temporalities (Amendment) Act, No. 11 of 1968.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Buddhist Temporalities (Amendment) Act, No. 11 of 1968.

body.heading: Amendment of section 2 of Chapter 818
body.raw_text: 2. Section 2 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance is hereby amended, by the insertion, immediately after the definition of "Public Trustee ", of the following new definition: - " Registrar-General " includes any Assistant Registrar-General; '
body.text: Section 2 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance is hereby amended, by the insertion, immediately after the definition of "Public Trustee ", of the following new definition: - " Registrar-General " includes any Assistant Registrar-General; '
